name: Freygish oom-pah accordion
desc: Klezmer accordion oom-pah in B freygish (phrygian dominant): low root ooms answered by offbeat B-major chord pahs, swinging to the E-minor iv every other phrase — the left-hand engine of a bulgar. wt_eorgan stands in for the squeezebox.

code.full: note("<[b2 [d#3,f#3,b3] f#2 [d#3,f#3,b3]] [b2 [d#3,f#3,b3] f#2 [d#3,f#3,b3]] [e2 [e3,g3,b3] b1 [e3,g3,b3]] [b2 [d#3,f#3,b3] f#2 [d#3,f#3,b3]]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_eorgan").attack(.006).decay(.22).sustain(.12).release(.07).hpf(200).lpf(2800).gain(${gain}).room(.22).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[b2 [d#3,f#3,b3] f#2 [d#3,f#3,b3]] [b2 [d#3,f#3,b3] f#2 [d#3,f#3,b3]] [e2 [e3,g3,b3] b1 [e3,g3,b3]] [f#2 [f#3,a#3,c#4] f#2 [d#3,f#3,b3]]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_eorgan").attack(.005).decay(.2).sustain(.1).release(.06).hpf(220).lpf(3200).gain(${gain}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.3)).room(.2).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(4).play()
